title: Townsville City Council Customer Request Management – Request for Service
grain: One publisher-supplied monthly aggregate row. Case-normalized Group Code + Category Code + Date is not guaranteed unique; downstream facts use a deterministic full-row key.

fields.name: Year
fields.description: Calendar year supplied by the publisher.

fields.name: Month
fields.description: Calendar month number supplied by the publisher.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: First day of the aggregate month in DD/MM/YYYY form.

limitations: This is aggregate Townsville data, not individual request or Hobart operational data.
Group and category taxonomies belong to Townsville and are not silently mapped to Rivulet categories.

The 2026-09-09 snapshot contains one collision after category-code case normalization and historical code-to-label drift. Raw rows, codes and descriptions must be preserved; category code alone is not a safe dimension key.
The publisher may revise historical rows; every refresh requires a new dated snapshot and hash.
